Once found, I must take them one by one, ensuring I drop any item I no longer need to make room for the next, strictly adhering to the two-item inventory limit. Finally, I will follow the recipe steps in order: pour water, swirl with fire wand, add sandwich, wave ice wand, add eye of newt, and add spider egg.

Then, I will ensure my inventory is clear (dropping the plate if present) to make room for the spider egg. Finally, I will execute the recipe steps in order: pour water, swirl with fire wand, add sandwich, wave ice wand, add eye of newt, and add spider egg.

New plan: I failed because I did not locate the spider egg, which is a required ingredient, and I repeatedly attempted to take the cauldron while holding other items, violating the two-item inventory limit. The correct strategy is to first locate the spider egg by searching the outhouse (where it was initially found) or the conservatory (where it appeared later). Finally, I will add the sandwich, wave the ice wand, add the eye of newt, and add the spider egg to complete the potion.
